# ⏱️ 1-HOUR POWER ELECTRONICS CRASH — Pass Guarantee

---

## 🔴 PART 1: COMPARISON TABLES (15 min → 8-10 marks guaranteed)

GTU **loves** comparison tables in new subjects. Ratta maar, 3-5 marks pakka.

### Table 1: SCR vs MOSFET vs IGBT (⭐ MOST LIKELY QUESTION)

| Parameter | SCR | MOSFET | IGBT |
|-----------|-----|--------|------|
| Type | Semi-controlled | Fully controlled | Fully controlled |
| Drive | Gate current | Gate voltage | Gate voltage |
| Speed | Slow (kHz) | Very fast (MHz) | Fast (100 kHz) |
| Drop | 1.5-2V | RDS×I (resistive) | 2-3V (constant) |
| Turn-off | Not self (needs commutation) | Self turn-off | Self turn-off |
| Power | High power (MW) | Low-medium power | Medium-high power |
| Use | HVDC, drives | SMPS, low power | EV, inverters, UPS |

**Why this will come:** First exam of PE → device comparison is the easiest 5-mark question a professor can set.

---

### Table 2: VSI vs CSI

| VSI | CSI |
|-----|-----|
| Voltage source input (capacitor in DC link) | Current source input (inductor in DC link) |
| Output = voltage waveform | Output = current waveform |
| Low impedance source | High impedance source |
| Used in: UPS, solar, EV | Used in: large motor drives |
| Needs freewheeling diodes | Needs series diodes |

**Why this will come:** Unit 3 has limited numerical scope → theory table is the go-to question.

---

### Table 3: Linear vs Switching Power Supply

| Linear | Switching (SMPS) |
|--------|-----------------|
| Uses transformer at 50Hz | Uses transformer at high freq (kHz) |
| Heavy, bulky | Light, compact |
| Efficiency 30-50% | Efficiency 80-95% |
| Low noise/ripple | Higher noise/ripple |
| Simple circuit | Complex circuit |
| Expensive at high power | Cheap at high power |

**Why this will come:** Unit 4 explicitly says "linear power supply, concept of switching power supply" → direct comparison question.

upply. Calculate average output voltage at α = 45°.

<summary>✅ Check Answer</summary>

- Vm = √2 × 120 = 169.7V
- Vdc = (2Vm/π) cosα = (2×169.7/π) × cos45°
- Vdc = 108.04 × 0.707 = **76.38V**

### Q3 (3 marks): What is duty cycle? A Buck converter has Vin = 60V and required Vo = 15V. Find D.

<details>
<summary>✅ Check Answer</summary>

Duty cycle D = Ton/T = fraction of time switch is ON.
For Buck: Vo = D × Vin → D = Vo/Vin = 15/60 = **0.25 (25%)**

</details>

---

### Q4 (3 marks): Name 3 differences between linear and switching power supply.

<details>
<summary>✅ Check Answer</summary>

| Linear | SMPS |
|--------|------|
| Heavy, bulky | Light, compact |
| Efficiency 30-50% | Efficiency 80-95% |
| Simple, low noise | Complex, more noise |

</details>

---

### Q5 (4 marks): What is an inverter? Give 4 applications.

<details>
<summary>✅ Check Answer</summary>

Inverter = converts DC to AC. Applications: (1) UPS (2) Solar inverter (3) EV motor drives (4) Industrial VFD

</details>

---

### Q6 (5 marks): A Boost converter has Vin = 5V, D = 0.8. Find output voltage. Also, if D = 0.5, find Vo.

<details>
<summary>✅ Check Answer</summary>

Vo = Vin/(1-D)
- At D=0.8: Vo = 5/(1-0.8) = 5/0.2 = **25V**
- At D=0.5: Vo = 5/(1-0.5) = 5/0.5 = **10V**

</details>

---

### Q7 (3 marks): Differentiate VSI and CSI (any 3 points).
